title: Hangover-cure Egyptian Comte Nigiri
description: A sour, flaky dish that combines Egyptian flavors with the richness of Comte cheese, perfect for a hangover cure.
instructions: Cut the Comte cheese into small pieces and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Soak the pita bread in water for 5 minutes, then squeeze out excess water.
In a small bowl, mix together the buttermilk, lemon juice, salt, and white pepper.
In a separate bowl, mix together the crushed dried mint and minced garlic.
Shape the Comte cheese into small nigiri shapes, about 1 inch in diameter.
Dip each piece of Comte cheese into the buttermilk mixture, then coat with the mint-garlic mixture, and finally coat with a piece of pita bread.
Heat the olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat, and cook the nigiri for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
